evals.name: reject-speculative-abstraction
evals.prompt: Review a proposed code change introducing 6 layers of interfaces, factories, and generic decorators for a single PostgreSQL query.
evals.expected_output: Application of KISS and YAGNI principles rejecting the over-engineering and simplifying to a direct repository.
assertions: Identifies speculative generalizations that violate KISS and YAGNI.
Recommends simplest working solution that fulfills current requirements.
Eliminates unnecessary factories, abstract classes, and redundant interfaces.

evals.name: functional-core-imperative-shell
evals.prompt: Refactor a tax calculation service that mixes database calls, network HTTP requests, and math logic in a single 300-line method.
evals.expected_output: Separation of pure tax calculation into a Functional Core and I/O coordination into an Imperative Shell.
assertions: Extracts business calculation into pure functions with zero I/O or external dependencies.
Imperative shell fetches data from database/network and passes plain values to the core.
Functional core is tested trivially in unit tests with no mocks required.

evals.name: apply-single-responsibility
evals.prompt: A UserService struct handles user validation, SQL queries, password hashing, JWT token creation, and email notifications.
evals.expected_output: Decomposition into cohesive single-responsibility components (PasswordHasher, TokenService, UserNotifier, UserRepository).
assertions: Splits bloated service adhering to Single Responsibility Principle (SRP).
Each component owns one reason to change.
UserService coordinates domain usecase flow via dependency injection.
